name: usage-desk
description: An offline-first AI usage, budget and agent intelligence desk

scripts.sync:bookmarklet: prettier --write claude-snapshot.js && node scripts/sync-bookmarklet.cjs && prettier --write index.html
scripts.format: prettier --write index.html agents.html numbers.html "assets/*.{js,css}" claude-snapshot.js "scripts/*.cjs" "tests/**/*.cjs" "docs/*.md" README.md package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.html agents.html numbers.html "assets/*.{js,css}" claude-snapshot.js "scripts/*.cjs" "tests/**/*.cjs" "docs/*.md" README.md package.json .prettierrc.json
